bottom_line: Auctions 1 and 2 have full market passes; auction 3 has first-pass research and its market pass is still running. Each lot shows sold prices, unsold results and asking prices separately, and only sold prices set a maximum bid. The most solid evidence: the 1964 Macallan (lot 768, four sold results, bid heavily contested), the Ebatarinja watercolour (lot 62), the Perth Mint gold and silver Federation coin (lot 876, one verified sale of A$1,000 hammer), Cardhu 2020 (lot 677) and the Tiffany bangle (lot 849). Many lots are already bid at or past their ceilings, and the cards say so. Wine has almost no sold data, only asking prices. Bids move fast near the close, so check them before you act.
